items.title: Stocks trade higher, lifted by crypto, commodities: AlphaCheck

items.title: Trump administration moves ahead with new crypto rules, with key bill stalled in Congress
items.summary: The Trump administration is aggressively pushing forward with executive actions to bolster the cryptocurrency industry as comprehensive regulatory legislation stalls in the Senate.

items.title: SoFi Climbs 5% as Robinhood Spikes 13%, Affirm Ticks Up: Is There a Crypto Connection Here?
items.summary: Bitcoin's breakout sent fintech stocks flying Friday, but the gains spread unevenly across SoFi, Robinhood, and Affirm in a way that reveals exactly which names actually have skin in the crypto game.

items.title: Moderna, Robinhood, Marvell, Tesla, SpaceX, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Moderna shares rise to close out a week of wild swings. Crypto stocks also extend their recent rally.

items.title: Crypto Stocks Gain as Bitcoin Heads for Best Week in Over Two Years
items.summary: Crypto stocks are rising Friday as bitcoin is headed for its best weekly performance in more than two years.  Shares of Coinbase Global, the largest crypto exchange in the U.S., were up 10% Friday morning.  Strategy, the bitcoin accumulation firm led by Michael Saylor, gained 8%.

items.title: Bitcoin Heads for Best Week Since 2024 as Trump-Fueled Crypto Rally Rages On
items.summary: It’s been a stellar week for cryptos—and it’s about more than just President Donald Trump calling for Congress to pass the Clarity Act.

items.title: Robinhood Advances 5%, Webull Ticks Up as Bitcoin’s Breakout Lifts Retail Brokerages
items.summary: Bitcoin's sharp breakout is sending shockwaves through retail brokerage stocks, but Robinhood and Webull are catching the move in very different ways, and the gap between them reveals something important about how each company is actually built.
